integrity: The exact increment has a self-contained all-size path-bijection proof and an independent finite rational checker; no claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Stationary homogeneous first-order two-state Markov voter dependence only. Does not extend to arbitrary dependent or heterogeneous voters; social-choice interpretation is mathematical, not a calibrated decision model. Historical priority remains provisional because the full Berend–Sapir 2007 article was not accessible.
title: Sharp finite-size Condorcet monotonicity for stationary Markov juries
